verdict.rationale: Opting out of tracking is a fair question for an analytics platform, for example SDK-level opt-out for end users or disabling the vendor's own telemetry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no opt-out mechanism. GDPR deletion/retrieval APIs, EU data residency and Session Replay sampling are adjacent privacy controls, not an opt-out of telemetry or usage tracking, so they earn no credit.
